title: Owner reorders in NERV's card and merges the PR
goal: The owner confirms a drag in the card ends as the new order on the dashboard
acceptance: With nerv:F-150 released, the owner drags one item in NERV's live index card, sees a PR open in voidbrain/coordinator that changes only docs/solution-order.md, merges it, and after npm run solution:refresh sees the new order on SOLUTION-DASHBOARD.md
A page with the exact steps is written by T03 and set as ownerLink
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: One drag, one PR review. Estimated 2026-11-26. Not a measurement.
